name: Get Rows
plugin_description: Integrates with Google Sheets to read, search, and write rows from Kizen agentic workflows.
action_description: Fetches rows from a sheet, keyed by header name. Optionally filter to rows whose filter_column cell exactly matches filter_value.

inputs.name: spreadsheet_id
inputs.label: Spreadsheet ID
inputs.hint: The ID from the sheet's URL: .../spreadsheets/d/{spreadsheet_id}/edit

inputs.name: sheet_name
inputs.label: Sheet Name
inputs.hint: The tab name at the bottom of the spreadsheet, e.g. Sheet1.

inputs.name: header_row
inputs.label: Header Row
inputs.hint: Which row contains the column headers (1-indexed). Leave blank to default to 1.

inputs.name: header_column
inputs.label: Header Column
inputs.hint: Which column the headers start in (1-indexed). Columns to the left are skipped entirely, e.g. a leading row-label column. Leave blank to default to 1.

inputs.name: filter_column
inputs.label: Filter Column
inputs.hint: Header name of the column to filter on. Leave blank to return every row.

inputs.name: filter_value
inputs.label: Filter Value
inputs.hint: Only rows whose filter_column cell exactly matches this value are returned. Required if filter_column is set.

outputs.name: rows
outputs.label: Rows
outputs.hint: JSON array string of row objects, each keyed by header name.
